description: Create an edited output from multiple source images using prompt, provider, resolution, and quality controls.

fields.name: imageList
fields.description: Public image URLs to combine or reference. Provide no more than 6 JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP images; each image must be at most 10 MB and between 800 and 4096 pixels.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Image model. Supported values: BANANA, BANANA_2, BANANA_PRO, WAN2_7, QWEN_IMAGE_3_PRO, SEEDREAM5, GPT_2_IMAGE, or AIDRAW_EDIT.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Optional fusion instruction, up to 600 characters.
fields.example: combine the product with the model in a clean studio scene

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: supplyType
fields.description: Generation route. Supported values: eco or stable. Defaults to stable.

fields.name: needOptimize
fields.description: Whether the prompt should be optimized upstream.

fields.name: template
fields.description: Optional fusion template. Supported values: outfit-fusion, outfit-try-on.

fields.name: quality
fields.description: GPT Image quality only. Supported values: low, medium, or high. Defaults to medium.

example.prompt: combine the product with the model in a clean studio scene
